notes: The steampunk diving-bell aesthetic is strong, with great brass and copper textures.
However, there are critical mechanical failures: the seek slider has a baked-in thumb, the volume knob didn't rotate, and the play/pause button is entirely missing (replaced by the volume knob).
improve: Ensure the play/pause button is actually generated in the layout.
Remove the painted thumb from the seek slider track so only the interactive sprite is visible.
Ensure the volume knob sprite is properly wired to rotate on interaction.
